    Mission report

    Terrain pipeline: MarsWalk automatically uses a processed USGS CTX DTM grid when data/terrain_grid.json exists. Otherwise it displays an explicit synthetic fallback. The route grid is 100 m; this spacing is not a claim of 100 m independent source resolution. Terrain implementation →

    How Marswalk works

    ▦

    USGS CTX terrain pipeline

    The included pipeline converts the verified Mars 2020 CTX TRN DTM (nominal 20 m posts) into the existing 100 m route grid. If that generated file is absent, MarsWalk says so and uses the legacy terrain only as an explicit fallback.

    ↝

    Four objectives

    The graph can be optimized for quickest travel, lower modeled terrain cost, science-demo priority, or a balanced trade-off. Terrain cost is a documented model score, not a NASA safety standard.

    ⌂

    Return-budget check

    At every route point, elapsed modeled time plus the fastest modeled walkback and a 30-minute reserve must fit the configured demonstration budget. Violations turn red.

    When real terrain is active, elevation comes from the USGS Mars 2020 CTX TRN DTM and slope is calculated from the processed elevation grid. Science priority, travel-speed parameters and the resource budget remain demonstrations/assumptions. NASA Mars Trek remains the geographic selection context.
